name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Buffers jump presses for a few physics ticks and logs every saved input to a live console. Press F6 to cycle stages.

show-console.name: Show Live Console
show-console.description: Open a separate console window that logs every buffered input.

start-stage.name: Starting Stage
start-stage.description: Stage the mod starts in (1-5). Stage 5 = buffer OFF.
